note: Conceptual/architecture lesson synthesizing a structured, three-pass integration security review (configuration, identity, monitoring) and covering inbound callout/webhook security specifically (HMAC signature verification over the raw request body, replay protection, guest user profile scope) since Chapter 1 focused mainly on outbound callouts. Taught through narrative and a full review-scenario Lab, no screenshots, per this course's conceptual/architecture policy. No Salesforce-native documentation was found describing a built-in inbound webhook signature-verification feature for custom Apex REST endpoints, so this lesson presents the HMAC/raw-body/replay-protection pattern as general, verified secure-API practice applied to Apex (consistent with Salesforce's own documented signing approach for its own outbound Data 360 webhooks) rather than citing it as a specific Salesforce platform feature.
